Four independent target READ/LIST pairs under opposite source READ/LIST/CREATE/UPDATE postures; effective READ and LIST populate/include, both write-origin outputs with Date/Binary mutations, independent target facts, parent/sibling/storage detachment and unchanged actual populated target documents retained by application afterPersist.

Six held operations, opposite branch settings, all settings flipped during hold, nested fresh read and subsequent fresh calls; real inherited/explicit/restored borrowing, immutable construction snapshot, warning membership per transition and logger failure containment.

Four READ/LIST pairs distinguish initiating READ borrowing on fallback from independent LIST; fresh fact stage, LIST admission and terminal false. Retained public tests protect other denial/row/field/target/HTTP/root branches.

Both write modes across all four branches: nested plain/Date/Buffer output mutations, unchanged payload/live afterPersist document/prepared and final snapshots/storage; genuine native selected-slot overflow after a committed create in both modes. TARGET supplies write-target native detachment.

Actual model/data basic/advanced/root grants; child field precedence and parent scope; HEAD/live defaults/restoration; original request custom acquisition and non-implied initiating gate; all-trusted excluded-origin helper/NEW/child/count/distinct smoke.

Real initialized middleware and exported guard with params/query IDs, missing-ID no application query, scalar/array/function permissions and original request this. Existing packed guard and private-input public cases retained.

Backend nested authority/helper/default/related/child-dimension rejection without model work; HTTP/root whole-sibling preflight before hooks/writes; inert same-named business data and terminal false versus malformed controls. Original 14-key wire matrix retained.

Atomic whole/dotted/inherited/nonenumerable retired operation keys; invalid mode/dependency/virtual settings and invalid global populate placement; options/registry unchanged; exact undefined restoration and ordinary business fields. Non-false populate values intentionally normalize to strict, not invalid enum values.

I/T disposable/borrowed view distinction and frozen owned boolean facts; later helpers/read do not acquire returned metadata authority; rich fulfilled maps fail; thrown/rejected hooks yield frozen empty facts with redacted structural logs.
Direct/root restricted composites deny without application distinct; fully granted composite and scalar child return fixed literals; dynamic/metadata/Mixed uncertainty never invokes distinct.

Actual acquired helper rejects outer position/sparsity/native limits before predicates; individually valid 4MiB rows fail cumulatively as a whole; two 4MiB rows plus one small held row at gate 2 prove admitted callback drains before failed settlement/no partial or late publication, followed by a fresh successful helper. No private budget injection.

One finite plain/Date/Buffer/Map/Set/typed-view bundle; owned configuration/snapshots/independent return values, old/new dataset versions, atomic malformed/native-proxy replacement, direct/root decorator detachment. Full original 20-value matrix stays lower-layer.

Initialized data core/service/public aliases small named helper loops, original request this, two field arguments/frozen empty facts by value; one-argument operation guard; acquired permission keys/has/hasKey/variadic and array methods/reserved names. No private constructor or EMPTY identity.

Two query/create modes; aligned frozen list/single/write contexts, real source IDs, dotted alias, expose allowlist, request-only _view/_edit separate from backend grants, denied fields, per-parent mutation independence and disable/strip postures.

Actual direct/root single/list/error envelopes retain supported metadata but recursively omit context/capabilities/provenance/private snapshots, including forbidden-control errors. No wire serializer import or fabricated result.

New actual installed ESM/CJS package-name imports cover runtime semantic names/default-callable identity/advanced parsers/processors/absent private runtime exports. Frozen existing packed private-exports.cjs failure-only resolves and strict Bundler/NodeNext/Node16 positive/negative compiles remain the blocked-private-path/type evidence, not duplicated or replaced by name absence. No private declaration/chunk-name contract.

recipeClarifications.cause: Two payload callbacks can finish before overflow; that alone cannot expose an admitted callback held during failed closure.
recipeClarifications.boundedInput: Two 4MiB payload rows plus one small held name row; maxHookConcurrency=2/maxBulkConcurrency=2.
recipeClarifications.result: All three predicates actually enter; other two finish while first remains held; no settlement before release; held completion precedes bad_request and no publication. Real input, no private state/turn counts.

recipeClarifications.cause: Populate policy values intentionally normalize every non-false defined value to strict; yes is not invalid.
recipeClarifications.boundedInput: Invalid placement of requireOperationAccessForPopulateQueries in global options; exact global/model options and registry retained.
recipeClarifications.result: Pass. Clarifies invalid populate configuration rather than inventing a boolean enum constraint; production/docs/policy unchanged.

recipeClarifications.cause: 16MiB cumulative payload is a collection ledger, not a blanket single-write native byte cap.
recipeClarifications.boundedInput: After real save, consumer afterPersist adds BSON Code with 20,001 selected scope slots to the live document without saving it again.
recipeClarifications.result: Both write modes return controlled bad_request while the small submitted business row remains committed. Grounded in README 308-336 and retained native public selected-scope tests.

recipeClarifications.cause: Existing packed consumers already execute blocked-private-path checks and strict positive/negative compiles.
recipeClarifications.boundedInput: Two new installed semantic-name imports reuse that retained evidence rather than duplicating the pack/type matrix or adding new failure-only import exceptions.
recipeClarifications.result: New ESM/CJS passed; existing sources exact ARTS-02 bytes. Retained runtime evidence remains ARTS-01/02, not a fresh ARTS-04 compile claim.

limitations: No full public-layer/default/invariant/internal or root/grouped/downstream run in ARTS-04.
Static guard and bounded tests do not prove arbitrary consumer equivalence.
Retained 97 original public files are preserved, not rerun here; ARTS-06 owns complete fresh runs.
